title: Cad Play Vertex Edge Kernel Solid
description: CAD play: moving vertices or edges produces wrong boxy blocky solids and overlapping shapes. Fix kernel solid computation on topology edit.
summary: Fixed leftover overlapping axis-aligned box meshes when editing box vertices. Renderer suppresses footprint box-preview display items and history archived-box overlays whenever the model already has committed solids (kernel tessellation is authoritative). useDocumentMeshes now compares async completion against a live revision ref so stale tessellations cannot repaint after gumball commits. Kernel brepForShapeSourceSolid only uses boxSolidPrimitiveFromShellVertices when the shell is still axis-aligned (matches solidForSolidRecord). All brepjs (26) and renderer (57) tests pass.
